reason: With Psalm 49 in view the letter groups of the first strip resolved into consecutive words of verses 5-10, keeping holoca- and -ment- from the first reading and replacing its other groups.
sources: Biblia sacra iuxta vulgatam versionem (Stuttgart edition), Psalmi iuxta Septuaginta and iuxta Hebraeos, Ps 49:5-20, as transcribed at vulgate.org/ot/psalms_49.htm (online transcription, no page image)
text:
Source-assisted reading of F-x6c5 (Orselina-Locarno, Biblioteca Madonna del Sasso, MdS 58 Ba 6/F2-6). Made with Psalm 49 in view; every line of both strips was reread on enlargements of the native images by a research reader. Square brackets mark what is lost or unread; round brackets resolve abbreviations; a question mark marks a doubtful reading.

Strip "ant": canvas 0 (mds_58Ba06_rinforzi_ant_cont), native box about 4760,2500,5300,3750; the same lines on canvas 1 (mds_58Ba06_rinforzi_ant_phy), box about 224,4252,813,5375, upside down. Psalm 49:5-10.

1  ]icia. [red uncial E]t a[        icia clear; "t a" clear
2  ]dex e(st) [hole; red descender of an initial] ud[     "dex", e with stroke and "ud" clear
3  ]t(ibi)? . d[hole]tuus           first group short, abbreviated, uncertain; "tuus" as minims and s
4  ]te [punctus elevatus] holocau[  "holoca" certain
5  ]p(er). [red and blue N]on [     p with bar through the descender; "on" clear
6  ]gib(us) tuis [                  "gib" and us-sign clear; "tuis" as minims and s, probable
7  ]menta [                         clear
8  tops of letters only, unread

Strip "post": canvas 3 (mds_58Ba06_rinforzi_post_phy), native box about 4930,2100,5290,3350; the same lines on canvas 2 (mds_58Ba06_rinforzi_post_cont), box about 308,4492,785,5896, upside down. Probably Psalm 49:15-20; the placing is not secure.

1  minims and a letter with a descender (]tu p[ ?), not placed
2  ]o, minims, a tall letter; red upright with a foot at the cut edge (left side of an initial); letters not resolved
3  ]e and three minims [..], not resolved
4  ]ero od[                         e, 2-shaped r, o, d, then tall strokes; probable
5  ]um [red S]                      minims and a red S
6  abraded, unread
7  ]tuu[ ?                          minims, weak
8  traces, unread
